scope: Bounded static review of namespace-only prepared original-command wrapper.

checks.argv: Original complete argv preserved; observed Node/Vitest/reporter and fresh owned producer path validated.
checks.exclusiveWrites: Phase directory/log/command/process/group/snapshot use exclusive creation, reporter retainswx. Vitest producer semantics are not changed; journal remains appendable.
checks.process: Popen start_new_session; normal unbounded wait; no outer timeout or terminating signal.
checks.group: Owned PGID only, signal0, five-second/50ms polling and positiveESRCH required.
checks.observer: Frozen reporter pin; actual PID/cwd; exclusive byte-identical raw snapshot; counts/errors/late/full teardown remain later audit.
checks.failure: ACTIVE/HALTED retained on uncertainty; no retry/source restoration/cleanup.
checks.environment: Inherited environment with privateHOME, Node22PATH, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH and disclosed observed metadata key overrides.
checks.deadlines: No original test/helper timeout or command argv rewritten.
checks.source: Before/afterHEAD equality only; does not independently prove every file-byte restoration.

limits: Static readiness only; assigned root/base/home and later runtime release remain root work.
Exit0/1 is process metadata, not test acceptance or kill.
No universal detached-descendant absence, native ABI measurement, OS/network/credential/cache isolation or healthy teardown proof.
Unbounded normal wait can remain unresolved indefinitely; no automatic kill recovery.

performed.writes: Only NEW wrapper static review JSON/MD pair.
